# menu.List docs still describe a submenu rest as pointer-only

## Context

#18759 / PR #18765 introduced the submenu rest for the pointer, and its docblocks described exactly that. #18780 / PR #18783 then made keyboard focus rest the same way: arrowing onto a parent item starts the same timer, reads the same two configs, and previews the same submenu. The docblocks were not widened with it. @neo-opus-vega noticed `cancelRest()`'s summary while reviewing #18796 (PRR_kwDODSospM8AAAABN1cAkA). A read of `src/menu/List.mjs` at `5d375d9722` finds five docblocks with the same gap, two of them public config docs.

## The Problem

A consumer reading `showSubMenuOnHover` learns that a resting pointer shows a submenu. Nothing tells them that arrowing onto a parent previews its submenu too, or that `subMenuHoverDelay` times both. The protected members describe half of their callers. That is the shape of the #18795 regression: the rest gained a second initiator while its descriptions stayed with the first, so nobody asked what ends a focus rest.

## The Architectural Reality

| docblock (`src/menu/List.mjs` at `5d375d9722`) | says | code |
|---|---|---|
| `showSubMenuOnHover` config (:123) | shows a submenu "once the pointer rests on it" | `startRest()` (:370) reads it, called from `onFocusMove()` (:686) and `onItemMouseEnter()` (:719) |
| `subMenuHoverDelay` config (:147) | "How long, in ms, the pointer must rest" | the same timer for both callers |
| `restTimeoutId` member (:185) | "a pointer rest still pending" | set by `startRest()` for both |
| `cancelRest()` (:354) | "Drops the pointer rest still pending" | bound to `mouseleave` (:211), and called by `startRest()` (:374) and `showSubMenu()` (:902) for either kind |
| `onItemRest()` (:723) | "the item the pointer rests on" | fired by either rest (:380, :383) |

Already accurate: `startRest()`'s summary (:363) names both inputs, and `onItemMouseEnter()` (:713) is the pointer path only.

## The Fix

Reword the five docblocks so a rest is started by the pointer or by keyboard focus. The two config docs name keyboard focus explicitly, because they are what a consumer reads. Comment lines only.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] **AC-1** — the five docblocks describe a rest as started by the pointer or keyboard focus; `showSubMenuOnHover` and `subMenuHoverDelay` say so in their own text.
- [ ] **AC-2** — the diff changes no code lines.

## Out of Scope

- Renaming `showSubMenuOnHover` or `subMenuHoverDelay` to input-neutral names: a public config change with its own migration cost.
- Rest behaviour itself (#18780, #18795 decided it).
